prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in to final onboarding step: Shift the sign-in screen to the very end of onboarding after desktop setup, so users interact with their pet before logging in.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "sign_in"]}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Direct one-click adopt flow: Skip photo uploading and customization screens by providing a single-click instant pet choice flow during adoption.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"headline": "Choose Your Companion", "button_label": "Adopt Instantly"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop pet launchpad redesign: Redesign the home intro step into a spotlight layout with an instant pet spawn preview and quick desktop control keys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "headline": "Meet Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is ready! Use Alt+P to summon or hide your pet anytime.", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Launch Pet", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}
3: [finish, new_screen] Pet care orientation screen: Insert a new orientation screen before completing onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and pet interaction.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Orientation Complete", "body": "Your desktop companion is active and ready."}, "new_orientation": {"headline": "Pet Control Basics", "body": "Drag your pet to move it around your desktop. Right click for interactions.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_orientation", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, notification] Generation status notification on wait screen: Add system notification prompt on the waiting screen to alert users when pet creation finishes if the app is minimized.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "headline": "Creating Your Pet...", "body": "We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Real-time generation wait progress tips: Display animated pet tips and time estimates on the waiting screen while pet files compile in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 5, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "style": "calm", "text": "Did you know? Desktop pets love resting on active windows."}]}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Certificate completion reward badge: Display an official adoption badge and reward unlock on the adoption certificate screen upon completing registration.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Adoption Official!", "body": "Your pet certificate is registered. Unlock special starter items upon setup completion.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Adoption Verified", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery safety hint on sign-in: Add a visible account persistence hint on the sign-in screen informing users how pets sync across re-logins.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your desktop pet data and customizations are saved safely to the cloud."}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Simplified path selection guidance: Simplify path selection text with clear, direct headlines emphasizing fast setup versus custom creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Setup Mode", "body": "Pick Quick Starter for instant play, or Custom Pet to upload your own design.", "hint": "You can change your pet anytime after setup."}}
9: [adoption, redesign] Adoption certificate stage redesign: Redesign adoption certificate screen into a stage layout replacing the static certificate with interactive naming and stamp component.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Name Your Pet", "replace": {"certificate": [{"role": "certificate", "type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "rounded"}, {"role": "certificate", "type": "button", "label": "Confirm Adoption", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}}

verdicts.reason: Reordering sign-in to the end of onboarding is explicitly allowed and retains all required steps.
Removes the photo upload onboarding step from the flow.
Redesigning the home intro screen layout while keeping its core job is allowed.
Adding a new orientation screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding system notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding wait progress indicators and tips during a real wait is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions unlocking special starter items (gifts/extras).
Adding sign-in persistence guidance text is allowed.
Path selection copy preserves options for both adopting and making a custom pet.
The replacement components remove the required official stamp from the adoption certificate.
